description: This file defines the WorkShiftSearchFilterParams class within the OrangeHRM Admin module, extending a base FilterParams class. It specifies allowed sort fields and sets a default sort field for work shift search filtering.

classes.name: WorkShiftSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that encapsulates filtering parameters for searching work shifts, extending base filter functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object with a default sort field set to 'workShift.name'.
